about: Gate Q3 sub-check HON-15 fixtures (IF-HONESTY.md, DEC-011). Each fixture is a whole world: the content of search/crawler-policy (null = the file is absent), the number of quotes in the quotes shard, and site/robots.txt. The committed state is CPF-00. Q3 is not built yet; no validator runs these today.
